messages.content: The museum approved the third night. Let's settle the flights and hotel now, but I still need a complete itinerary to send back for final travel approval before anything is charged.

Understood. I’ll keep everything unbooked. For Monday, November 16, the best-fitting outbound is the nonstop from Atlanta at 2:05 p.m., arriving Detroit at 4:02 p.m. For Thursday, November 19, I found two nonstop returns: 8:05 a.m. to 10:02 a.m. for a $238 round-trip total, or 11:40 a.m. to 1:37 p.m. for $284 round trip. Do you need to be back in Atlanta before noon?
Yes. Use the 8:05 Thursday return. The installation can run through 6:00 Wednesday, so I don't want to reconsider that evening flight.

That fixes the pairing at $238 round trip: ATL-DTW Monday, November 16, 2:05-4:02 p.m.; DTW-ATL Thursday, November 19, 8:05-10:02 a.m. Both are nonstop. The fare includes one standard seat assignment and a carry-on; a checked bag would be $35 each way. The ticket is changeable without a change fee, but any fare difference would apply. Shall I compare the Midtown hotels for all three nights?
Yes. Please give me the full totals, not just nightly rates, and tell me how I would actually get to the museum in the morning.

For November 16-19, I have three workable options. The Inn on Ferry Street is $641.37 total, including taxes, in a queen room. It is about 0.4 mile from the museum, an approximately eight-minute walk along Ferry Street and then Woodward. The El Moore Lodge is $608.46 total in a queen room; it is about 1.1 miles away, usually 7-10 minutes by rideshare or roughly 22 minutes using the QLINE after a short walk to the Canfield stop. The Siren Hotel is $574.92 total in a queen room; from downtown, the QLINE from Grand Circus to Ferry Street takes about 18 minutes, followed by a four-minute walk, though waiting can make the full trip 25-35 minutes. None of those totals includes optional parking or incidentals.
Does the Inn total include every mandatory hotel charge? And is the walk straightforward before 8:00 in the morning?

Yes. The $641.37 includes the room charges, state and local taxes, and the property’s mandatory service charge. There is no separate destination fee listed. The route is direct and mostly level: east on Ferry Street, then north along Woodward to the museum entrance. At a normal pace it is about eight minutes, and no transit connection is required.
What about breakfast and the cancellation deadline there?

A continental breakfast is included in that rate. Cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. local time on Saturday, November 14. A cancellation after that deadline is charged at one night plus tax. Check-in begins at 3:00 p.m., and checkout is by noon Thursday.
The Inn sounds most practical. Before I choose it, compare its complete trip cost with the El Moore. Include airport transportation and the checked artwork case both ways.

Using the same $238 airfare, a checked case at $35 each way, and estimated ground transportation, the Inn itinerary is $1,039.37: $238 flights, $70 baggage, $641.37 lodging, and about $90 for DTW-hotel-DTW rides. The El Moore itinerary is $1,036.46 before local museum trips: $238 flights, $70 baggage, $608.46 lodging, and about $120 for airport rides because of the location and expected Thursday pickup. Adding three estimated morning or evening rides between El Moore and the museum would bring it to about $1,087. The Inn costs nearly the same overall and avoids daily transport.
Use the Inn. Is a queen the only room at that total? I only need one bed.

The $641.37 option is the lowest complete total and has one queen bed. A one-king room is available for $689.82 total under the same cancellation terms. Since one bed is sufficient, the queen keeps the lodging cost $48.45 lower.
Keep the queen. Now check the timing Thursday. I don't want an itinerary that depends on leaving the hotel at the last possible minute.

For the 8:05 a.m. departure, I would schedule the hotel pickup for 5:30 a.m. The drive to DTW is generally 25-35 minutes at that hour, giving an expected terminal arrival around 6:05 a.m. That leaves about two hours for checking the case, security, and reaching the gate. Even with a 20-minute traffic delay, you would arrive about 1 hour 40 minutes before departure.
Good. What is the Monday schedule from landing through hotel arrival?

The flight lands at 4:02 p.m. Allow about 25 minutes to deplane and retrieve the checked case, then approximately 35-50 minutes by car to Midtown in late-afternoon traffic. The planning arrival at the Inn is 5:30 p.m., with a reasonable range of 5:10-5:45 p.m. Check-in will already be open, and Monday evening remains free after the case is secured.
The case has to go to the museum Tuesday morning, not stay with me all day. Add that and the inspection start.

I’ll add an 8:00 a.m. Tuesday departure from the Inn with the case for the short walk to the museum, allowing extra time for handling it. Arrival at receiving would be about 8:15 a.m. for the 8:30 a.m. condition inspection. The case remains with the museum through installation, so it does not affect Wednesday or Thursday airport transport.
Actually, receiving asked me to come to the loading entrance on John R. I shouldn't walk the case around to the public entrance.

Corrected. Tuesday’s plan will use a prearranged vehicle from the Inn at 7:55 a.m. to the John R loading entrance, with an estimated 8:05-8:10 arrival. I’ll add $18 as a local transportation allowance. The inspection still begins at 8:30 a.m. The revised estimated trip total is $1,057.37.
Please assemble the approval version with the work schedule and make it very clear that nothing has been booked.

Approval itinerary, not booked: Monday, November 16, nonstop ATL-DTW departing 2:05 p.m. and arriving 4:02 p.m.; retrieve the checked artwork case and take a car to The Inn on Ferry Street, with planning arrival at 5:30 p.m. Lodging is one queen room for three nights, November 16-19, at $641.37 including all mandatory taxes and charges. Breakfast is included, and cancellation is free through 6:00 p.m. Detroit time on Saturday, November 14. Tuesday, depart by prearranged vehicle at 7:55 a.m. with the case for the John R loading entrance, arrive by 8:10 a.m., and begin the condition inspection at 8:30 a.m. Wednesday, remain available through the installation finish at 6:00 p.m. and stay the third night. Thursday, November 19, hotel pickup is scheduled for 5:30 a.m. for the nonstop DTW-ATL flight departing 8:05 a.m. and arriving 10:02 a.m. Estimated cost is $1,057.37: $238 airfare, $70 checked-case fees, $641.37 hotel, $90 estimated airport transportation, and $18 Tuesday transfer. Meals and incidental charges are excluded. No flight, room, or transportation has been reserved; this is the completed itinerary for final museum approval.
